findings.summary: A NEEDS_RECONCILIATION run with a driver-state mismatch can never be reconciled: reconcile loads through _load_cont, whose restore check raises on every fresh load (PR-18).
On a mismatch, startup recovery re-raises before its crash rules: DISPATCHING is never moved to UNKNOWN and COMMITTED never verified, and reconcile handles only UNKNOWN.
The D8 handler blocks every PROPOSED/AWAITING_APPROVAL/APPROVED action, broader than cancel and recovery; state it as intended.
